PLAN NOTES

Built for a careful
path to production.

Are the feeds live today? +

Delta Lateral Indices is currently in concept and development. Sandbox access will begin with testnet and evaluation feeds.

What does confidence mean? +

It summarizes the quality and agreement of source observations used for aggregation. It is not a guarantee that a price or forecast will be correct.

Can plans support custom assets? +

Custom asset coverage and forecast horizons are planned for Network agreements, subject to source quality and validation.
